-- JOB MARKET INTELLIGENCE | GOLD V2 — published snapshots
-- Run on Synapse Serverless SQL (Built-in), database: job_market.
-- Preserves Gold v1 and dbo.vw_job_snapshots.
-- Gold v2 notebook writes _manifest only AFTER all three datasets succeed.
-- NOTE: SQL reads manifest Parquet content; it cannot verify Spark's _SUCCESS file.
--       For strict completion verification, use the validation query below and
--       confirm _SUCCESS in ADLS before exposing freshly processed dates.

-- 1. Control view: committed snapshot metadata.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS
SELECT
    CAST(m.snapshot_date AS varchar(10)) AS snapshot_date,
    CAST(m.run_id AS varchar(100)) AS run_id,
    m.job_count,
    m.skill_count,
    m.location_count
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/_manifest/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS m;
GO

-- 2. Business views: only partitions whose date AND run_id occur in manifest.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2 AS
SELECT
    CAST(j.filepath(1) AS date) AS snapshot_date,
    j.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/fact_job_snapshots/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS j
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS m
    WHERE m.snapshot_date = j.filepath(1)
      AND m.run_id = j.run_id
);
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_skills_v2 AS
SELECT
    CAST(s.filepath(1) AS date) AS snapshot_date,
    s.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_skills/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS m
    WHERE m.snapshot_date = s.filepath(1)
      AND m.run_id = s.run_id
);
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_job_locations_v2 AS
SELECT
    CAST(l.filepath(1) AS date) AS snapshot_date,
    l.*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://stjobmarketdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/jobs/v2/bridge_job_locations/snapshot_date=*/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS l
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS m
    WHERE m.snapshot_date = l.filepath(1)
      AND m.run_id = l.run_id
);
GO

-- 3. Read access for the existing Power BI principal.
GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2 TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];
GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_skills_v2 TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];
GRANT SELECT ON OBJECT::dbo.vw_job_locations_v2 TO [powerbi-reader@adamablergmail.onmicrosoft.com];
GO

-- 4. Validation: each manifest must match the numbers in exposed tables.
WITH facts AS (
    SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10), snapshot_date, 23) AS snapshot_date,
           COUNT_BIG(*) AS actual_jobs
    FROM dbo.vw_job_snapshots_v2 GROUP BY snapshot_date
), skills AS (
    SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10), snapshot_date, 23) AS snapshot_date,
           COUNT_BIG(*) AS actual_skills
    FROM dbo.vw_job_skills_v2 GROUP BY snapshot_date
), locations AS (
    SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10), snapshot_date, 23) AS snapshot_date,
           COUNT_BIG(*) AS actual_locations
    FROM dbo.vw_job_locations_v2 GROUP BY snapshot_date
)
SELECT m.snapshot_date, m.run_id,
       m.job_count AS expected_jobs, f.actual_jobs,
       m.skill_count AS expected_skills, s.actual_skills,
       m.location_count AS expected_locations, l.actual_locations,
       CASE WHEN m.job_count = ISNULL(f.actual_jobs, 0)
              AND m.skill_count = ISNULL(s.actual_skills, 0)
              AND m.location_count = ISNULL(l.actual_locations, 0)
            THEN 'OK' ELSE 'CHECK' END AS count_status
FROM dbo.vw_gold_v2_commits AS m
LEFT JOIN facts AS f ON f.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
LEFT JOIN skills AS s ON s.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
LEFT JOIN locations AS l ON l.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
ORDER BY m.snapshot_date DESC;
GO

-- Expected: existing dates 2026-10-26/27/28 return OK.
-- Note: If count_status = CHECK, do not refresh Power BI.
